parole.testo: Variant of dialectal (Visokë) llo (“moisture, dampness”), from Proto-Slavic *lojь (“suet, tallow”); cf. Bulgarian лой (loj), Serbo-Croatian lȏj. Doublet of lojë. Svane/Ylli prefer a different loan from Bulgarian ло́ква (lókva, “puddle; (dial.) flood plain”).
From a South Slavic language, ultimately from Proto-Slavic *němьcь (“foreigner”), from *němъ (“mute”). Compare Serbo-Croatian Nemac (“a German”), Macedonian Немец (Nemec), Bulgarian немец (nemec).
